column1: # Go dependency license allowances for apps/backend. Each row admits ONE license on ONE library,
# by exact path. scripts/go-licenses-check.sh passes each library to `go-licenses check --ignore`
# and then asserts, from `go-licenses report`, that the library is still in the graph, still
# carries exactly this license, and that no unlisted library shares its path as a prefix.
# Adding a row is a policy change: it needs a recorded security-policy ruling (its UTC stamp) in the `ruled` column.
